views.name: delivered_orders_by_month_year
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS month,
    strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) AS year,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM olist_orders
GROUP BY strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date), strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date)
views.description: aggregated count of orders grouped by month and year, filtered by delivery status

views.name: monthly_delivered_orders_pivot
views.body_sql: SELECT month, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2016' THEN order_count END), 0) AS delivered_orders_2016, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2017' THEN order_count END), 0) AS delivered_orders_2017, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2018' THEN order_count END), 0) AS delivered_orders_2018 FROM delivered_orders_by_month_year GROUP BY month
views.description: pivoted relation transforming year-based counts into separate columns per year, keyed by month
